macros.name: citeall
macros.doc: The second optional argument sets the number of entries of the .bib (more precisely the .bbl-file) printed by \citeall. By default everything is cited.

macros.doc: The second optional argument sets the number of entries of the .bib (more precisely the .bbl-file) printed by \citeall. By default everything is cited.

macros.name: citeallfinentry
macros.doc: The last item is finished by \citeallfinentry (default nothing).

macros.name: citeallgroupseparator
macros.doc: The entries are separated by a \par, this can be changed by redefining \citeallgroupseparator.

macros.name: citeallseparator
macros.doc: By default the item of an entry are separated by a comma and a space.
